title: Crvena Zvezda top FMP to clinch KLS title
description: FMP - Crvena Zvezda 59-71 Crvena Zvezda clinched KLS title. They overcame KK FMP Meridian on the road to complete the sweep of the championship series. Nikola Ivanovic (190-G-1994, agency: BeoBasket) came off the bench to topscore with 21 points. Crvena Zvezda limited their opponents to just 9 points in the first period to open a 6-point lead. FMP increased the tempo in the second frame. They sank 22 points in the second period to narrow the deficit at 3-point mark 31-34. Crvena Zvezda however came off the locker room swinging. They poured in 25 points to ensure a 14-point lead. FMP slowed their opponents down in the fourth period but could not avoid the loss. Nikola Kalinic (203-F-1991) tossed in 12 points for the winning side. Marko Radonjic (191-PG-1993) answered with 14 points for FMP.
